notes: Codex may refine implementation filenames, but these semantic command entrypoints must exist by S07.
Commands must return non-zero on failure and produce source-bound machine-readable evidence where noted.
Do not make verify:v06:development invoke real WSGS or release-only work.

commands.name: pnpm test:v06:contracts
commands.purpose: Run v0.6 source, negotiation, result, view-model and AG-UI contract tests.

commands.name: pnpm test:v06:postgres
commands.purpose: Run real PostgreSQL migration, source identity, lease, recovery and scope tests.

commands.name: pnpm test:v06:local-e2e
commands.purpose: Run actual-listener SACS HTTP/AG-UI E2E with real PostgreSQL and controlled upstream adapter.

commands.name: pnpm check:v06:integration-readiness
commands.purpose: Inspect locked WSGS source, contract and configured environment without claiming execution.

commands.name: pnpm test:v06:real-wsgs
commands.purpose: Run source-built/approved real SACS→WSGS Grounding Job E2E and write bounded evidence.

commands.name: pnpm verify:v06:development
commands.purpose: Run all development-track commands, migrations, architecture, secrets, lint, typecheck and build; write DEVELOPMENT_VERIFICATION.json.

commands.name: pnpm verify:v06:integration
commands.purpose: Require readiness, execute real WSGS tests and validate INTEGRATION_EVIDENCE.json.

commands.name: pnpm verify:v06:release
commands.purpose: Run release-only container/SBOM/compose checks only with explicit release authorization.

commands.name: pnpm verify:v06
commands.purpose: Run development verification and evidence consistency; must not silently execute release work.

commands.name: pnpm verify:v06:evidence
commands.purpose: Validate source locks, per-row evidence, digests and completion markers.
